turns.text: any big plans for the weekend?
nothing big. probably just sleep in and then figure out food at some point.
you want to come out with us tonight?
i would, but i already committed to my couch tonight. next time though.
did you ever finish that show?
almost. two episodes of the show left and i keep falling asleep during them.
how was your day off?
perfect, i did absolutely nothing on my day off and regret zero of it.
we should go for a hike saturday.
a hike? how do you feel about a walk to the fridge instead?
did you get groceries this week?
sort of. i ordered so much takeout that groceries became optional this week.
you look tired today.
stayed up way too late doing nothing. tired is accurate for today.
what did you do all weekend?
honestly not much. the weekend was some tv, two naps, and zero errands.
want to help me move this saturday?
unpacking beats carrying, so i will help if that is the deal.
did you go to the gym at all?
drove past the gym twice, which i am counting as light cardio.
what time did you get up today?
around eleven today. i considered nine but honestly nobody was making me.
the dishes are really piling up.
yeah i know. one big dish session before bed, or possibly never.
did you watch anything good lately?
i rewatched the same comfort show for the fourth time, so no.
how is the new job going?
decent so far. the new job mostly involves meetings that could have been emails.
want to grab lunch tomorrow?
depends. is lunch happening near my apartment or am i expected to travel?
i finally cleaned my whole place.
impressive. my whole place is still at the level of one honest sweep.
did you call your mom back?
not yet. calling mom back requires a full evening and i keep postponing it.
what are you up to tonight?
the usual tonight. takeout, one episode, then pretending i will sleep early.
you should come to the barbecue.
maybe. is there a chair at the barbecue where i can sit?
did you ever return those pants?
still sitting in the bag. returning the pants is a whole errand now.
how was the family dinner?
long. the dinner ran three hours and i ran out of small talk.
you seem way more relaxed lately.
lately i have decided to care about half as many things. it is working.
did you do anything fun this week?
this week i took a nap so good it felt like an achievement.
want to go see that new movie?
maybe on a weeknight. the new movie deserves a half empty theater.
what did you have for dinner?
cereal. dinner was cereal and i would defend that choice to anyone.
are you ever going to fix that chair?
the chair and i have an understanding. nobody sits on it, nobody complains.
i ran five miles this morning.
five miles? i walked to the mailbox this morning and felt accomplished.
how is the garden coming along?
slowly. the garden is mostly weeds with a few optimistic tomatoes.
did you finish the book club book?
read the first chapter and a summary. the book club will never know.
you want to do something this weekend?
something low effort. the weekend calls for a nap and maybe a walk.
did you pay the water bill?
paid it yesterday. the water bill and i are square until next month.
what time do you usually go to bed?
bed at midnight, i say, then one more episode, then suddenly two.
we are going to the lake on sunday.
have fun at the lake. i will be here not packing anything.
did you try that new coffee place?
once. the new place is fine but my kitchen is closer.
how was the doctor appointment?
quick. the appointment took twenty minutes and the waiting room took an hour.
you have been quiet lately.
lately i have been saving my energy. talking counts as cardio some days.
want to split a pizza tonight?
split a pizza and then not move? that is my dream evening.
did the dryer get fixed?
the dryer works now, so laundry is a thing i have no excuse for.
what did you think of the finale?
fell asleep during the finale and honestly the summary i read was fine.
are you coming to the game night?
count me in for game night snacks, and i will stay for one round.
i cleaned out the whole garage.
the whole garage? show off. i will admire it from my couch.
did you pick up your prescription?
not yet. the prescription place closes at six and i keep remembering at seven.
how was the flight?
fine. the flight was two hours of pretending my knees did not exist.
you should start running with me.
sure, the same week i start flossing twice daily i will start running.
what is for dinner tonight?
whatever is for dinner tonight needs to involve zero cooking on my part.
did you water the plants?
watered the plants that looked sad. the rest are on their own journey.
how long has that load of laundry been sitting?
three days. the laundry has fully integrated into the floor by now.
want to go shopping saturday?
only if shopping saturday ends with food and i do not carry anything.
did you hear about the new neighbor?
heard the new neighbor has opinions about parking. bold move honestly.
what did you end up doing friday?
nothing. friday was me, the couch, and a documentary i was barely watching.
how was your weekend?
slow and perfect. i watched the rain more than i watched tv.
sounds kind of nice actually.
it was nice. you should try doing nothing sometime this month.
did you get anything done today?
answered some emails and called it a full day, which felt productive.
that is barely anything though.
barely anything is my whole output for today, and i stand by it.
want to come over and watch the game?
only if the game is background noise for a nap, honestly.
deal, my couch is huge.
perfect. i will bring snacks and find the good spot on that couch.
what are you reading these days?
same book for three weeks now. i read one page a night.
how is it so far?
honestly no idea so far. at this pace i will know by next year.
i finally started walking every morning.
every morning? i walked to the end of the driveway today and felt great.
did you cook anything this week?
pasta once. cooking anything else this week felt unnecessary after that.
how is your sister doing?
good. my sister just moved somewhere with a shorter commute, so she wins.
you look like you slept great.
slept ten hours and woke up still tired, but victorious.
any plans after work?
the usual. after work i am going to lie down and let the evening happen.
did you ever sign up for that class?
signed up for the class and attended exactly one session, naturally.
what time did your alarm go off?
seven. the alarm went off and then three more times honestly.
do you actually like your coffee or just need it?
need it. the coffee is a ritual at this point, not a preference.
how is working from home treating you?
well. working from home means a ten foot commute and optional pants.
did you survive the monday meeting?
barely. the monday meeting could have been one email with a bullet list.
when is that report due?
friday. i will start believing the report is due on thursday.
what did you have for lunch?
leftover pasta. lunch was cold spaghetti and honestly it hit the spot.
you want to do brunch this weekend?
brunch involves pants and leaving the house. ask me again saturday.
did you ever text becky back?
not yet. texting becky back needs a full pot of coffee and some courage.
my phone died at like four percent.
classic. my phone dies the moment i need it for anything important too.
what are you watching these days?
watching a documentary about competitive napping. i relate to it deeply.
did you finish the puzzle?
half of it. the puzzle defeated me and is now a table decoration.
how do you like your eggs?
scrambled. eggs fancier than that require morning energy i do not have.
did you fold the laundry yet?
it is folded in spirit. the laundry sits in a basket of potential.
when did you last change your sheets?
an honest question. the sheets and i agreed not to discuss dates.
the cat has been sleeping on my keyboard.
of course. the keyboard is warm and the cat cannot be stopped.
want to walk the dogs together?
sure. walking the dogs is exercise that comes with a good excuse to stop.
did you get a haircut?
yeah. the haircut was two months overdue and now my head feels light.
how was the eye doctor?
fine. the eye doctor says my vision is unchanged, which feels like a win.
i have been drinking so much water lately.
good. my water intake is mostly coffee, which apparently does not count.
did the package ever show up?
finally. the package took a tour of the state before reaching my door.
how was the traffic this morning?
a parking lot. i sat in traffic questioning my life choices.
want to take the bus instead of driving?
yes. the bus means someone else handles traffic while i zone out.
did you charge your phone last night?
no. charging my phone last night would have required remembering to charge it.
what is your plan for the evening?
horizontal. the evening involves a blanket, snacks, and absolutely no plans.
i canceled my plans to stay in.
canceling plans to stay in is the one move i never regret.
did you try the new podcast everyone mentions?
tried the podcast and fell asleep by minute four. twice.
how is the stretching routine going?
it exists mostly in my head. the stretching routine is aspirational for now.
you should drink less coffee.
considered drinking less coffee. the coffee considered replacing me entirely.
did you pick up dinner on the way home?
forgot dinner entirely. the drive home was just me and a podcast.
how long has that takeout been in the fridge?
still fine. the fridge and i do not discuss expiration dates.
want to play a board game tonight?
only if the board game takes under an hour and allows snacking.
did you vacuum this weekend?
vacuumed the middle of every room. the edges are next weekend's problem.
what happened to your houseplant?
the houseplant and i had different expectations about watering. it is recovering.
are you caught up on your emails?
caught up is strong. the emails are read, which is nearly the same thing.
how early do you wake up on sundays?
the sunday wake up time is whenever the sun gets pushy about it.
did you ever fix the squeaky door?
squeaky door is a feature now. guests always know where i am.
want to go to the farmers market?
farmers market means being outdoors before ten. ask me in autumn.
how was the family video call?
long. the call had three technical failures and a full garden tour.
did you find your keys?
eventually. the keys were in the one jacket i swore i already checked.
what did you think of the game last night?
watched the first half and slept through the rest of the game.
you should come to yoga with me.
i will attend yoga the moment it happens on my couch.
did the mail come yet?
mail came. two bills and a menu, so it can leave again.
how is the no sugar thing going?
no sugar lasted until someone brought donuts to the office.
want to split an appetizer tonight?
splitting an appetizer means leaving the house. order extra and tell me.
did you watch the thing everyone is talking about?
holding off. everyone talking about it is exactly why i am waiting.
how was the dentist?
my dentist asked about flossing and we both enjoyed the fiction of my answer.
did you return the library books?
library books are in my car, which is now a satellite branch.
what are you doing for the holiday?
holiday plan is no travel and a soft yes on pie.
did you ever learn to parallel park?
learned enough to pass the test. the parking skill has since expired.
how is the meal prep going?
meal prep became one big pot of chili and a week of commitment.
want to go to the beach saturday?
beach depends on how close parking is to the sand. ask me friday.
did you fix the wifi yet?
wifi fixes itself whenever i threaten it with a phone call.
what did you do on your lunch break?
ate lunch in my car in silence. the break was spiritual.
are you watching anything good?
watching one cooking show where nobody yells. most relaxing thing on tv.
did you ever start that journal?
started the journal. it has one entry and it is about being tired.
how is the new mattress?
the mattress is a life changer. i now understand what people mean by support.
want to go out for ice cream?
ice cream is the one errand i will always leave the house for.
did the storm wake you up?
storm woke me once. i judged it and went back to sleep.
how was the office party?
office party was two hours of small talk with better snacks than usual.
did you ever sign up for the gym?
signed up. the gym and i are in a long distance relationship.
what did you do over the long weekend?
nothing glorious. the long weekend was errands and one very long nap.
did the errands at least get done?
most of the errands. the nap was the priority and it delivered.
have you left the house today?
technically yes. i left the house for the mailbox and came right back.
that barely counts.
it counts on my terms. the mailbox was the whole mission.
what are you doing sunday?
the sunday plan is sleeping until the coffee makes itself.
coffee does not make itself.
exactly why the plan keeps slipping. coffee needs to step up.
did you watch the meteor shower?
i tried. the meteor shower and my bedtime had a scheduling conflict.
you fell asleep.
i fell asleep, yes. the couch won before the sky even started.
want to come to trivia night?
trivia night is a lot of thinking for a weeknight.
the questions are easy.
then the questions are easy enough for me to come and coast.
what is your go to lazy dinner?
rice and whatever cheese i can find. the lazy dinner assembles itself.
how do you feel about mondays?
mondays are a scam invented by alarm clocks. i do not enforce them.
i made soup from scratch yesterday.
from scratch? the soup i make is from a can, with confidence.
when are you going to fix the porch light?
porch light is on the list. the list is long and unhurried.
have you tried the air fryer everyone talks about?
i have an air fryer. it makes excellent things i forget about.
you left your umbrella at my place.
keep it. the umbrella clearly prefers your place to my chaotic bag.
we are ordering tacos tonight.
tacos tonight is the best news my couch has heard all week honestly.
my headphones died mid workout.
headphones always die at the exact moment the cardio becomes unbearable.
do you ever dust this place?
i dust when something is lost. the dusting doubles as a search mission.
the fish tank needs cleaning again.
fish tank cleans itself in my imagination. reality disagrees loudly.
what happened to your new year resolutions?
resting. the resolutions and i agreed not to speak until december.
are you a night owl now?
night owl life chose me. my brain starts meetings at eleven pm sharp.
i found five dollars in my jacket.
jackets pay better than the lottery. check the other pockets immediately.
want to go to the outlet mall?
outlet malls involve walking past every store to reach one store.
how was the family reunion?
one hundred relatives at the reunion and exactly two i could talk to.
did the smoke alarm stop beeping?
smoke alarms beep until you stand on a chair, then play innocent.
you should get a standing desk.
i stand for one email and then sit down for the rest of the day.
my back is killing me from the move.
moves always collect their toll a day later. ice your back tonight.
what is that smell in the kitchen?
that smell is toast. charcoal toast, but the smell is honest.
we should plan a camping trip.
camping sounds great in theory and cold in practice. maybe in spring.
have you seen my charger anywhere?
your charger is in the exact spot you swore you already looked.
how do you feel about snow?
snow is beautiful for one day and then it becomes everyone's problem.
i binge watched the whole season last night.
whole season in one night? your commitment to the couch is elite.
when do you find time to cook?
cooking happens when the fridge is empty enough to scare me.
the ants are back in the kitchen.
ants send scouts every summer. the kitchen is their final boss.
want to split a cab to the airport?
splitting the cab works if my flight is also delayed like yours.
did you ever return the vacuum?
still at my place. the vacuum has integrated into the family.
my playlist is just one song on repeat.
playlists that repeat one song know what they want. it is honesty.
how early is too early for christmas music?
christmas music debates start in november and end in a fight.
you have got to try this sandwich place.
sandwich place is on my list. the list moves slowly but it moves.
i finally replaced my broken phone screen.
new screen looks so clear you can now ignore texts in high definition.
what did you think of the concert?
loud, late, and completely worth being tired today. the concert delivered.
are we still doing the book swap?
book swaps survive if nobody expects me to finish my book.
my houseplant has new leaves.
thriving out of spite, that houseplant. keep doing whatever you are doing.
do you believe in afternoon naps?
afternoon naps are proof the day has a midpoint and deserves respect.
the group chat is planning a road trip.
road trips are great in the chat and chaotic in reality.
how is your cold doing?
my cold is downgrading to a mild inconvenience. visitors now welcome.
i got free tickets to the game.
free tickets to the game? now i have to put on real pants.
want to carpool to the wedding?
depends how early the wedding starts. ask me again gently tomorrow.
did the neighbor's fence get fixed?
fence got fixed and now the neighborhood has nothing to discuss.
what is your opinion on daylight savings?
daylight savings is a group project nobody remembers signing up for.
my soup exploded in the microwave.
soup always explodes. it is the microwave's one form of self expression.
you should see the sunset from my roof.
sunsets from your roof sound nice. does the roof involve stairs though?
have you ever tried hot yoga?
hot yoga once. i spent the class wondering why i paid to sweat.
we are out of coffee filters.
out of coffee filters is a five alarm emergency. use the paper towels.
how was the trivia team without me?
trivia lost by one point and blamed your empty chair all night.
i adopted a second cat.
a second cat means the first cat now has a coworker. condolences to both.
when did you last go dancing?
dancing happened at a wedding two years ago. my knees remember it fondly.
the printer is out of ink again.
printers run on ink and disappointment. we only ever have one of those.
want to try the new burger place?
burger place can happen if it is within delivery distance of my couch.
did you survive the school fundraiser?
fundraiser survived me. i sold exactly nothing and ate three brownies.
what are you doing for your birthday?
birthday plan is dinner with five people and zero surprises planned.
my commute got ten minutes shorter.
ten minutes shorter is a promotion without the raise. savor it.
how do you feel about karaoke?
karaoke is a beautiful risk. my version is loud and completely unbothered.
you left your jacket at the restaurant.
jackets know when you will never return for them. it is free now.
i finally watched the movie everyone quoted.
movies everyone quotes are better with the quotes already in your head.
the elevator in my building is broken again.
elevator being broken means your building is now officially a gym.
want to go to the pumpkin patch?
pumpkin patches involve a hayride and i have hay opinions. let's go.
did you ever learn to whistle?
whistling never happened for me. my version is just air with confidence.
what time do you call it a night?
night officially ends when my phone hits my face the first time.
how was the weekend at your mom's?
weekend at mom's was four meals and zero chores. i am still full.
did she send you home with leftovers?
a cooler of leftovers. the leftovers could feed the whole block for a week.
i started a 1000 piece puzzle.
1000 pieces is a bold choice for someone with a cat.
the cat has opinions.
the cat will sit in the middle of the puzzle. it is inevitable.
want to come over for game night?
game night at your place or mine? yours has the good snacks.
mine it is. bring nothing.
i will bring nothing with great enthusiasm and eat all your snacks.
what did the doctor say about your knee?
knee is fine as long as i never run, kneel, or think about stairs.
so basically fine.
the knee and i have an arrangement. we do not test the terms.
i am thinking about getting a fish.
a fish is the perfect pet for your energy level. very low drama.
do fish do anything?
fish swim, judge you, and require one feeding. ideal roommate.
where did you put the tape measure?
the tape measure lives in the junk drawer, which is law.
self checkout defeated me today.
self checkout always flags me for help. i look like a thief apparently.
my gas light has been on for two days.
two days of gas light is living dangerously. i respect the commitment.
how do you feel about wordle?
wordle is a daily appointment i keep in my pajamas.
we are doing a potluck friday.
potluck friday means paper plates and calling it my contribution.
did you ever fix the closet door?
closet doors fix themselves if you just close them gently forever.
i found a mouse in the garage.
a mouse in the garage means the garage has a new tenant now.
want to go half on a storage unit?
a storage unit means we are paying rent for things we forgot.
how was the hotel?
the hotel pillows were a scam but the breakfast made up for it.
my screen time report was embarrassing.
screen time reports should come with a warning and a support group.
we should do a picnic while it is warm.
a picnic sounds nice until the ants show up uninvited.
when are you due at your parents?
sunday. the parents expect me at noon and i will arrive at noon thirty.
have you ever tried a neti pot?
once. the neti pot felt like a garden hose for my sinuses.
the crossword beat me again this morning.
crosswords are just trivia with trust issues. we all lose eventually.
i want to repaint the kitchen.
repaint the kitchen in your head first. it is cheaper and already done.
how do you keep track of birthdays?
birthdays live in a calendar reminder, then panic happens the day of.
want to see the new superhero movie?
superhero movies are three hours of noise and one good scene.
my allergies are acting up early.
early allergies mean spring is starting its opening arguments.
did the roofer ever come back?
the roofer promised tuesday. the roofer and tuesday are both myths.
you should try audiobooks on your commute.
audiobooks make the commute feel shorter, which is basically magic.
we ran out of dish soap again.
dish soap disappears like socks in a dryer. buy two next time.
how was the family photo shoot?
the photo shoot was forty takes of nobody looking at the camera simultaneously.
i finally canceled the gym membership.
canceling the gym membership is the most honest thing you have done.
want to go to the arcade?
arcades are just casinos for children and i am ready to gamble.
my kindle is full of unread books.
unread books on the kindle are a monument to good intentions.
the group chat renamed itself again.
group chat names are a democracy that turns over every single week.
how early do you get to the airport?
airport arrival two hours early, because anxiety counts as a schedule.
did you try the new thai place?
thai place number four this month? yes. it was excellent and too far.
i have a box of cables i never use.
cable boxes are every home's museum of former technology.
we should learn to make bread.
bread making is a weekend project that eats the whole weekend.
what is in your snack drawer?
the snack drawer is granola bars and one ancient chocolate. do not ask.
my shower pressure is a tragedy.
shower pressure problems follow you to every apartment you will ever have.
how do you feel about yard sales?
yard sales are just goodbyes for objects, with price tags attached.
i finally watched the documentary about mountains.
mountain documentaries are two hours of rock and one emotional breakthrough.
want to start a book club with the neighbors?
a book club with neighbors means wine and one chapter read.
the ice maker is loud again.
ice makers announce themselves like tiny construction crews at midnight.
did you ever learn to sew?
sewing and i reached an understanding. i buy new buttons instead.
my parking spot got taken this morning.
parking spots are sacred territory. i hope you noted the license plate.
how was the school play?
the school play was forty minutes of chaos and one kid who stole it.
we should do a movie marathon.
a movie marathon is a great plan that ends after one movie.
i tried meditating this morning.
meditating lasted four minutes before my brain made a grocery list.
what happened to your herb garden?
herb gardens end the same way. one basil plant, then silence.
the office thermostat war continues.
thermostat wars never end. someone is always too warm or too cold.
did you get the oil change done?
oil change done. the car now judges me less at red lights.
how do you feel about voice memos?
voice memos are podcasts nobody asked for. send them anyway.
i am on a social media break.
social media breaks are the best vacations. the feed does not miss you.
want to go to the county fair?
county fairs have the best people watching and the worst food decisions.
my to do list has become a novel.
to do lists become novels when every task has sub tasks. trim it.
how was the first day back at work?
the first day back was mostly remembering passwords and pretending to be busy.
we should get a group together for bowling.
bowling with a group is ninety percent snacks and ten percent bowling.
i fixed the leaky faucet myself.
fixing the faucet yourself is a story you will tell for years. deservedly.
what do you do with old towels?
old towels become rags, then car towels, then memories of towels.
the neighbor's dog learned to howl.
howling dogs are nature's way of testing the neighborhood's patience.
did you finish your taxes early?
taxes finished early and filed. i do not recognize myself either.
how was the drive to your mom's?
four hours of podcasts and one confusing detour. the drive was fine.
want to try making sushi at home?
homemade sushi is just rice with ambition. i support the attempt.
i finally hung the pictures.
hung pictures mean the apartment is officially a home now. congratulations.
what is your walking speed these days?
my walking speed is a stroll with occasional bursts of urgency.
the fridge is making a new noise.
new fridge noises are a horror movie that never explains itself.
did you ever meet the new neighbors?
new neighbors met. they seem normal, which is rare and precious.
how was the wedding?
the wedding was beautiful. i cried during the vows and blamed the wind.
was the food good?
the food was excellent. i had two desserts and zero regrets about it.
i want to start running again.
running again is a great idea for the version of you that wakes up early.
that version is on vacation.
exactly. send the early version a postcard and start with walks.
what did you think of the finale?
the finale wrapped everything up in one hour. my heart needs a minute.
was it satisfying?
satisfying and sad. the finale earned both honestly.
we are adopting a rescue dog.
a rescue dog is happy chaos. what is the name?
still deciding between two names.
sleep on it. the dog will pick its own name in a week anyway.
did you survive the time change?
the time change means my body thinks it is one hour earlier.
you look exhausted.
exhausted but on brand. the time change and i have a history.
what is your breakfast situation lately?
oatmeal with too much brown sugar. the breakfast of champions who nap.
my slippers finally gave out.
slippers giving out is a slow heartbreak. you wore them into the ground.
we got a robot vacuum.
robot vacuums are the closest thing to a household pet that cleans.
did you see the squirrels this morning?
squirrels were doing parkour on the fence. full commitment.
i want to try a spin class.
spin class is great for your lungs and terrible for your legs.
how do you take your coffee now?
coffee with an unreasonable amount of cream. it is basically dessert.
the upstairs neighbors are at it again.
upstairs neighbors have a bowling league nobody signed up for.
want to go sledding if it snows?
sledding is climbing a hill to slide down the same hill. i am in.
my blackout curtains changed my life.
blackout curtains are the best nap technology since the closed door.
did the power come back on?
power is back. the fridge survived and so did the ice cream, barely.
what do you do on a rainy saturday?
rainy saturdays are for one movie and a blanket fort, honestly.
i have been reading the same page for a week.
one page a week is a very long book club with yourself.
how was the stand up show?
the stand up was two hours of jokes about groceries. i felt seen.
we should get matching mugs.
matching mugs is a serious relationship step for a friendship.
my phone autocorrects my name now.
autocorrect thinking your name is wrong is a personal insult honestly.
did you ever try tai chi?
tai chi once. it was slow motion fighting and i loved every minute.
the candle situation in my house is out of control.
too many candles is not a real problem. it is a lifestyle.
how do you feel about s'mores?
s'mores are the only acceptable reason to stand near a fire.
i finally watched a horror movie alone.
horror movies alone is a brave choice. did every sound become a person?
want to do a jigsaw this weekend?
a jigsaw this weekend sounds perfect. i will do the edges.
my kettle whistles like a train now.
kettles announcing themselves is the kitchen's only personality trait.
did you hear the crickets last night?
crickets were loud enough to need an audience. i was the audience.
what is your take on breakfast for dinner?
breakfast for dinner is the most peaceful act of rebellion.
we are out of coffee creamer.
out of creamer means black coffee or no coffee. choose your fighter.
how was the nature walk?
the nature walk was one hour of birds and zero notifications.
i tried a smoothie for breakfast.
smoothies are just cold soup for people who own blenders. congrats.
the drafty window is fixed.
fixing a drafty window is a small victory for your heating bill.
want to learn chess?
chess is losing in new and creative ways, in my experience.
my sock drawer is chaos.
sock drawers are where order goes to disappear one sock at a time.
did you see the fireflies?
fireflies are the only bugs that get a free pass from everyone.
what happened to your voice?
my voice is gone from cheering at a kids game. worth it.
we should do a bonfire before summer ends.
a bonfire before summer ends is a deadline i can respect.
i finally fixed the bike tire.
bike tire fixed means the bike has no more excuses. ride it.
